limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not been run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
interface_cycle_semantics: Original ports preserved; asynchronous active-high reset dominates synchronous load, which dominates enabled right shift. Otherwise q holds. Updates occur on positive clock edges or reset assertion with no extra latency.
numeric_width_decisions: Four-bit unsigned register; shift inserts zero at bit 3 and discards bit 0.
static_review: Single always_ff driver, nonblocking assignments, explicit reset and load priority, no extra ports or initialization.
testbench_coverage: All 16 data values across all four load/enable combinations; pre-edge and negative-edge stability; repeated shifts through zero; asynchronous reset between edges and reset priority; bounded timeout and fatal mismatch checks. No initial value assumed before reset.
